owner_map: G44Pack: The map was produced by G44Pack2's `jo.py`, an implementation of jaymosley07's [#653](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/653) joint two-call nomination (a bounded pair MILP with integer stop-loss and majorization rows; a pair move is accepted when every margin is >= 0 and one is > 0). It ran on research/gauge44-layered's LN5c map: `jo.py ../G44Pack/maps/LN5c LLx/joN5c --pairs 300 --passes 8 --seconds 3`. LN5c itself came from G44Pack's `lns5.py` LNS (`--plan LL/05gm/PLAN.json --owners LL/05gm/OWNERS.json.gz --seconds 1800 --workers 1 --k 120 --sub 120 --b 0.00165`, seed 1, 4th improvement). `LL/05gm` came from `loop.py wL2 LL 10`, starting from Mine636's `widen_repair.py` and G44Pack's `rewidth.py` on bit589b's L1g4 map.
